info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Transactions API
info.description: The Customer Account Transactions API enables businesses to record and manage transaction data associated with specific customer accounts. This API facilitates the submission of transaction details, allowing financial institutions and service providers to efficiently track and analyze customer spending behaviors. Users such as financial analysts and account managers can utilize this endpoint to input transaction information seamlessly. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure accurate record-keeping and enhanced financial reporting.

post.summary: Create a new transaction for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new transaction associated with a specific account belonging to a customer. Ensure you provide all required transaction details in the request body to successfully create the transaction.
